Combining Volume Rendering with Adaptive Ray Marching in Neural ...
Differentiable Ray Marching Both PixelNeRF [6] and NerFormer [3] use volume rendering with evenly spaced points along the query ray, which might contain many points in empty spaces. Since volume rendering is a slow explicit rendering technique, this could result in wasteful computational resources.
